item.title: Two dead and more than a dozen missing after 'terrifying' flash flood hits Grand Canyon
item.description:
Rescue workers are searching for over a dozen hikers who went missing after a flash flood ripped through the Grand Canyon over the weekend. The National Park Service confirmed that at least 15 people were missing or unaccounted for in remote areas of the canyon after heavy rain on Saturday caused flash flooding. At least one 46-year-old man was killed during the flooding as authorities anticipate more severe weather to hammer the area on Monday. The flooding occurred Saturday in Bright Angel Canyon and Phantom Ranch. Bright Angel Canyon is reached by the most popular trail in the Grand Canyon, and Phantom Ranch is a well-known area at the bottom of the canyon where overnight lodging cabins are available.
